proposal.summary: The Genexis Platinum-4410 v2.1 router exposes plaintext passwords for built-in accounts (Admin, GENEXIS, user3) in the source of its web login page http://192.168.1.1/cgi-bin/index2.asp, allowing an attacker who can view that page to obtain credentials and potentially control the device.
proposal.cwe_quote: Genexis Platinum-4410 v2.1 Home Gateway Router discloses passwords of each users(Admin,GENEXIS,user3) in plain text behind login page source “http://192.168.1.1/cgi-bin/index2.asp".

PR.quote: Genexis Platinum-4410 v2.1 Home Gateway Router discloses passwords of each users(Admin,GENEXIS,user3) in plain text behind login page source “http://192.168.1.1/cgi-bin/index2.asp".

C.quote: This could potentially allow a remote attacker access sensitive information and perform actions such as reset router, changing passwords, upload malicious firmware etc.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by loading the referenced page source on a test device; if confirmed, notify vendor to remove plaintext credentials from web pages, rotate default credentials, and issue firmware update to secure credential storage and access.

evidence_quotes.claim: Plaintext passwords disclosed in page source
